scripts.test: node --test tests/tooling.test.cjs tests/prisma-runner.test.cjs tests/oracle-deployment.test.cjs tests/demo-teacher.test.cjs && pnpm architecture && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:scalar
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter nexquiz-auth-api generate && pnpm --filter nexquiz-game-api generate
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm --filter nexquiz-auth-api db:deploy && pnpm --filter nexquiz-game-api db:deploy
scripts.verify: pnpm generate && pnpm db:validate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:validate: pnpm --filter nexquiz-auth-api db:validate && pnpm --filter nexquiz-game-api db:validate
scripts.test:game:http: pnpm --filter nexquiz-game-api exec jest --runInBand test/session-http.db.spec.ts test/live-gateway.db.spec.ts
